description: Per-sample Titanium stage labels, BETA algorithm. Separate from v1 so the original titanium labels stay readable.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id, fleet_name, pad_name, name AS well_name, id AS well_id, api_num, record_ts, created_ts, rate_slurry, press_mainline, prop_conc_blend_denso, prop_conc_blend_auger, prop_conc_inline, prop_conc_target, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS titanium_first, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS titanium_final, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_status, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS processed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0
